description: Official Python SDK for the Segmind API — run 200+ image, video, audio, and language models, PixelFlow workflows, file uploads, and fine-tuning.
rules: As of v1.1.0, segmind.run() is the async (v2, queue-backed) path and returns a dict; use segmind.run_sync() for a single blocking v1 call, which returns an httpx.Response (save response.content to a file).
run_async() was removed in v1.1.0 — use run() instead.
Authenticate by setting the SEGMIND_API_KEY environment variable, or pass api_key to SegmindClient.
For long-running video models, use segmind.submit_async(...) then job.wait(timeout=...) instead of run().
